subject: Cross-timeband kickoff — scheduling windows, venue access & shuttle ops
messages:
From: Laura Henderson <laura@skylinehealth.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.example, rishi_malhotra@redwood.example
Cc: Skyline Health Logistics <ops@skylinehealth.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 14:10:00 -0800
Subject: Kickoff workshop — proposed Nov 28-30 windows and onsite needs

Hi Soojin / Rishi,

We’re excited to get the kickoff scheduled for the Redwood integration. Our core team is available the week of Nov 28 — primary preference is Nov 29 (US East morning) through Nov 30 midday. We have a hybrid audience (NY office + remote APAC folks).

A few logistical asks up front:
- Can Redwood provide shuttle recommendations and pickup windows for participants arriving at JFK? We’ll have a small cohort arriving Nov 28 late evening (6 people).
- Venue access: we need badge pre-approval for 25 on-site attendees and an early load-in window on Nov 29 (07:30–08:30).
- Any standard AV runbook and floorplan we can share with our facilities team?

Attached our rough attendee list and preferred time blocks.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-min sync if helpful.

Best,
Laura Henderson
Director, Partnerships
Skyline Health

Attachments: kickoff-attendee-list.csv
From: soojin_lee@redwood.example
To: Laura Henderson <laura@skylinehealth.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.example, grace_oconnor@redwood.example
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff workshop — proposed Nov 28-30 windows and onsite needs

Hi Laura — thanks, this looks good.

Quick notes:
- We can support Nov 29 09:00–13:00 ET for the core sessions and Nov 30 09:00–12:00 ET for working groups. That covers APAC remote participation with late-evening East Coast anchors — we’ll send Zoom links with mirrored room (more below).
- I’ve looped Rishi (ops) and Grace (CS lead) to coordinate shuttle/vendor and facility prep.
- We have a standard AV kit and a 2-page venue floorplan I can share; planning to attach the PDF once we confirm final headcount.

Action items for Skyline: confirm final on-site headcount by EOD Nov 24 and badge roster (full names + companies). Also note any dietary restrictions for the lunch setup.

I’ll reach out to our shuttle partner for quotes and block tentative pickup slots. Would you like dedicated return shuttles late Nov 28, or will attendees make independent transfers?

Would a 30-minute planning call tomorrow (Nov 24) at 10:00 ET work for you? If not, suggest two alternate slots.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Lead — Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.example

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.example
To: soojin_lee@redwood.example, grace_oconnor@redwood.example
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Shuttle options + vendor availability (internal)

Soojin / Grace — I reached out to BlueLine Shuttles and asked for a standby quote for Nov 28 evening pickups (JFK terminals 1 & 4) and return transfers on Nov 30 (afternoon). They gave rough rates and capacity: 1x 14-passenger minivan ($120 flat), 2x 24-passenger coach ($350 each).

Notes:
- If Skyline wants reserved returns (preferred), we need to confirm exact pickup addresses and number of suitcases (for coach vs van decision).
- I can provision a vehicle hold and add a small insurance endorsement for company events.

I’m attaching the quote stub I received; will finalize once Soojin confirms headcount and pickup times.

Attachments: shuttle-quote.xlsx

Rishi
Operations Manager — Redwood Inference
From: soojin_lee@redwood.example
To: Laura Henderson <laura@skylinehealth.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.example, grace_oconnor@redwood.example, mateo_alvarez@redwood.example
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Confirmed windows + venue access plan (Nov 29–30)

Hi Laura — looping back with a concrete ops plan. Thanks for the attendee list.

Confirmed schedule (all ET):
- Nov 29: 08:00–09:00 load-in & AV check; 09:00–13:00 plenary sessions (room A); 13:00–14:00 lunch (catered boxed lunches).
- Nov 30: 08:45–09:00 room prep; 09:00–12:00 breakouts + closeout.

Venue access and badges:
- Facilities will pre-print badges for 25 names you provided. Please confirm any additions by 23:59 ET Nov 24. Day-of check-in will be on the lower lobby desk; we’ll request expedited door access for the load-in window (07:30–08:30).

Shuttle plan (proposal):
- BlueLine will provide 1x coach for Nov 28 midnight arrival cluster (pickup 23:15 from Terminal 4 curb) and 1x coach for Nov 30 16:30 return to JFK. If you prefer smaller vans, we can swap but need confirmation by noon Nov 25.
- Cost will be billed to Skyline via invoice from BlueLine; Redwood can coordinate payment on your behalf if you prefer.

Attachments included: venue-floorplan.pdf (room layout + AV ports), shuttle-quote.xlsx (vendor rates).

Next steps:
- Laura: confirm returns vs independent transfers and any last-minute attendee additions.
- Rishi: hold BlueLine coach(s) pending Laura’s confirmation; please include pickup addresses in the contract.
- Grace: I’ll work with you on the hybrid AV bridge and recording policy (opt-out for any speakers).

If this looks good, I’ll send calendar invites with the two day blocks and the Zoom bridge for APAC.

Thanks,
Soojin
Senior Solutions Lead — Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: venue-floorplan.pdf, shuttle-quote.xlsx
From: Laura Henderson <laura@skylinehealth.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.example
Cc: Skyline Health Logistics <ops@skylinehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 17:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Confirmed windows + venue access plan (Nov 29–30)

Hi Soojin — this is perfect, thank you.

We’ll take the coaches for arrival/return as proposed. No further additions to the headcount — final roster attached. Please proceed with holding the vehicles.

Also confirming boxed lunches with two vegetarian options.

See you next week — really appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best,
Laura
